sources.title: Prompt Engineering Best Practices for AI Models
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering is the practice of designing and refining inputs to guide large language models (LLMs) toward accurate, relevant and high-quality outputs. For developers, researchers and AI professionals, it is an important skill for getting reliable and useful results from AI systems.

sources.title: Prompt engineering best practices for 2026 | Claude by Anthropic
sources.snippet: What is prompt engineering? Prompt engineering is the craft of structuring instructions to get better outputs from AI models. It's how you phrase queries, specify style, provide context, and guide the model's behavior to achieve your goals.
